topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I found out about the job. Or, I should say, the lack of a job. I thought I knew them so well, trusted them with the kind of secrets that sit heavy in your chest. Now, every conversation feels different, weighted with things unsaid. I keep thinking about all the times they mentioned work, the stories they told. I’m not sure how to face them. What if there’s more they haven’t told me? What if I don’t really know them at all? I need to figure out what to say, how to ask without making things worse. Maybe they had a reason. Maybe.
